name: rocketcyber-mcp
description: The first CLI and MCP server for RocketCyber Managed SOC, with triage and posture analytics no console page or API call computes.

rocketcyber_api_token.title: ROCKETCYBER_API_TOKEN
rocketcyber_api_token.description: Sets ROCKETCYBER_API_TOKEN for the RocketCyber MCP server.

rocketcyber_base_url.title: RocketCyber API base URL
rocketcyber_base_url.description: Base URL for the RocketCyber API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

rocketcyber_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
rocketcyber_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

rocketcyber_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
rocketcyber_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

rocketcyber_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
rocketcyber_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

rocketcyber_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
rocketcyber_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on RocketCyber requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
